name: @doconda/mcp

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a finished document: Word, PDF, PowerPoint, Excel or an artifact (a web page with its own shared database, e.g. a poll or a team checklist). Choose only the format: Doconda works out what kind of document it is (contract, letter, report…) from the request. Give `prompt` to have it written, or `markdown` with the content already written. Waits until it is ready and returns download links.

format.description: docx → Word (+ PDF); pdf → only the PDF; pptx → PowerPoint (+ PDF); xlsx → Excel (+ PDF); artifact → web page. If the user didn't say, leave it out and Doconda decides from the prompt.

prompt.description: What to write, in the user's words (topic, audience, length, tone). Formatting wishes too, e.g. 'blue centred headings, with a cover page'.

markdown.description: Content already written, in Markdown (instead of prompt). For an artifact, the content its page shows.

style.description: Optional: the look in plain words, e.g. 'blue centred headings, Lora font, page numbers, table of contents'.

name.description: Optional: a name to find it later, e.g. 'Contrato piso Malasaña'. It also names the files.

source_file_ids.description: Uploaded files (upload_file) or documents already made (their id, from list_documents): documents to base the text on (up to 5, with prompt) and pictures to put in the document (up to 10; with markdown, refer to them as ![caption](img:1), the first picture).

data.description: Artifacts only. shared (default): everyone with the link sees the same data (polls, team lists). local: each visitor keeps their own in their browser (calculators, personal checklists). With retention none, only local.

retention.description: Optional: how long Doconda keeps it once finished (none = 15 minutes). Without it, the project's retention (30 days unless changed). The user should save the file before then.

quality.description: Optional. fast: the cheapest and quickest (about a minute), any style, but it can't copy a file's design. standard: more care, takes minutes. best: the highest quality and price, e.g. to copy a file's design or to edit with comments or tracked changes. auto (default): Doconda picks the level the request needs. The price of the highest level it may use is held from the balance while the document is made and what is not used is returned: with a low balance, pick fast or set max_quality.

max_quality.description: Only with quality auto: the highest level Doconda may choose. It caps the price and the amount held, e.g. standard.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file (Word, PDF, PowerPoint, Excel — also the old .doc, .ppt and .xls —, TXT, Markdown, or a PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP picture; up to 20 MB) to review or edit it, or to use it as a source. Returns its file_id. Give `path` for a file on this computer.

path.description: Absolute path of the file on this computer.

url.description: A public URL to download the file from.

content_base64.description: The file's bytes in base64 (for small files).

filename.description: Its name with extension, e.g. contract.docx. Needed with content_base64.

tools.name: review_document
tools.description: Check an uploaded Word, PowerPoint, Excel or PDF file (also .doc, .ppt, .xls) for problems and fix the safe ones without touching the content, no AI: tables off the page, split signatures and broken numbering in Word; text overflowing its box or shapes off the slide in PowerPoint; formula errors, numbers stored as text or sheets too wide to print in Excel; scanned pages without text, missing title or language in PDF; amounts in words that don't match the figures in all of them. Files with macros are rejected; other dangerous content (external links and pictures, embedded files, automatic actions…) is removed. Returns the fixed file (old formats come back as .docx/.pptx/.xlsx) and how many problems are left; get_report lists what was found and fixed.

file_id.description: From upload_file, or the id of a document Doconda made (list_documents).

tools.name: edit_document
tools.description: Change an uploaded Word, PowerPoint, Excel or PDF file as asked (e.g. 'blue headings and add a confidentiality clause'). Only what is asked changes; the rest stays identical. Returns the new file; get_report lists every change, with the text before and after.

file_id.description: From upload_file, or the id of a document Doconda made (list_documents).

instructions.description: What to change, in the user's words.

quality.description: Optional. fast: the cheapest and quickest (about a minute), any style, but it can't copy a file's design. standard: more care, takes minutes. best: the highest quality and price, e.g. to copy a file's design or to edit with comments or tracked changes. auto (default): Doconda picks the level the request needs. The price of the highest level it may use is held from the balance while the document is made and what is not used is returned: with a low balance, pick fast or set max_quality.

max_quality.description: Only with quality auto: the highest level Doconda may choose. It caps the price and the amount held, e.g. standard.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: The latest documents made in this project (newest first), with their id and name. Use an id as file_id to review, edit or read one, or in source_file_ids to create from it.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: A document's status and fresh download links (they expire after 5 minutes).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Get what Doconda found and did in a finished document (from create_document, review_document or edit_document). Returns problems_left: what is still wrong, with its severity (error, warning or info) and message; fixes: each automatic fix tried, applied or rejected, with the reason for a rejection; and for an edit, changes: each passage added, changed or removed, with the text before and after. Empty lists mean nothing is left or was tried. Call it after a review or an edit, or when a result says "see get_report"; for the status and download links use get_document. Until the document finishes it returns report_not_ready; once its retention ends, content_deleted.

tools.name: read_artifact_data
tools.description: What people have saved in an artifact's page (e.g. poll votes): its collections, or one collection's records, newest first.

collection.description: Optional: one collection's records instead of the list of collections.

instructions: Doconda creates, reviews and edits documents (Word, PDF, PowerPoint, Excel) and artifacts (web pages with shared data). Share the links it returns with the user; they expire, so call get_document for fresh ones.
